before.body:
The XSTO M4 is engineered to meet the demands of UK roads and mixed terrain with a perfect blend of innovative technology, comfort, and safety. Its gyro-stabilized seat and terrain-optimized Mecanum wheels offer plush ride quality and secure handling on tarmac, kerbs, cobbles, and wet conditions like black ice. Whether commuting across urban pavements, tackling park trails, or navigating narrow indoor spaces, the M4 is designed to keep you balanced, comfortable, and confident.

The Ideal UK Road Wheelchair: XSTO M4 Features

  • Advanced gyro-based stabilization maintains seat balance on slopes and uneven ground, automatically reducing speed on descents for safety.
  • Mecanum front wheels deliver 360° rotation and enhanced traction, allowing the chair to overcome curbs up to 5 cm (2") and obstacles effortlessly.
  • Powerful high-torque motors drive smooth performance across diverse terrains, with a top speed of up to 6 km/h and range up to 17 km on a full charge.
  • Height-adjustable seat (from 45cm to 80cm) with tilt capabilities (25° backward, 16° forward) enhances reach and seating comfort, ideal for everyday tasks on varying surface heights like benches or kitchen counters.
  • Foldable design and three-part disassembly make transport and storage simple, fitting easily into most car boots and public transport spaces.
  • Weatherproof materials and sealed electronics protect components, suitable for the UK's variable weather.
  • Compact turning radius of 78 cm allows navigation through tight spaces and elevators common in UK buildings.
  • Supports up to 130 kg user weight with a strong frame and reliable brakes ensuring safety on wet tarmac and slopes.

Understanding UK Road and Safety Compliance with XSTO M4

The XSTO M4 aligns with UK regulations for powered wheelchairs, classified as Class 3 with a 4 mph pavement mode and 6 km/h road capability. The chair can be equipped with essential visibility aids such as front and rear lights, reflectors, and indicators for road safety compliance. Its build quality and testing meet international ISO standards, ensuring stability and crashworthiness on UK's bumpy, cobbled streets and wet conditions.

Practicality and Comfort for British Journeys

The M4’s ergonomic design features adjustable armrests and footrests for balanced support, pressure-relieving cushions, and a modular frame that adapts to your postural needs. The intuitive joystick or smartphone app control allows precise speed and direction management. Its suspension system and all-terrain wheels reduce vibration and tilt for a smooth ride, whether tackling urban crossings or rural park paths.

Maintenance, Insurance, and Long-Term Value

XSTO supports users with ongoing care advice, including tyre and brake checks, battery monitoring, and part replacements. The M4’s modular design helps keep maintenance straightforward and cost-effective, with available VAT relief potentially reducing upfront costs. Insurance options range from basic liability to comprehensive mobility plans covering public transport and road use.

Future-Proof Your Mobility with XSTO M4

Adjustable and upgradeable, the M4 prepares you for changing mobility needs with modular mounting points for accessories and power add-ons. Its strong frame and smart electronic system allow for future technology integration, including enhanced lighting and joystick upgrades.

Conclusion

The XSTO M4 power wheelchair offers UK users a reliable, comfortable, and versatile mobility solution tailored for the road and terrain challenges specific to British environments. Its combination of award-winning technology, safety features, and user-centric design make it a standout choice for anyone seeking freedom and independence on UK roads and beyond.

Ready to test the XSTO M4? Explore home demos and dealer locations to experience this advanced wheelchair firsthand.

Its gyro-stabilized seat and 360° rotating Mecanum wheels handle kerbs, cobbles, and wet conditions confidently, while high-torque motors provide smooth power up to 6 km/h with a 17 km range. Adjustable seating, foldable design, and weatherproof materials enhance convenience and durability. Compliant with UK Class 3 wheelchair regulations and ISO safety standards, the M4 offers a reliable, versatile solution for urban and rural mobility across Britain.

The XSTO M4 combines powered movement, self-levelling technology and electric seat lifting. Choosing a chair starts with the places you want to use it: the doorway at home, your local shops, a favourite café or a journey to see friends.

Start with your routes

Bring your everyday routes to a demonstration with Bentech Medical. Ask about doorway clearances, turning space, transfers, slopes and the surfaces you expect to encounter. Check the current M4 specifications and the manual for the exact chair supplied.

Self-levelling technology does not make every surface suitable. Follow the manufacturer’s operating limits and weather guidance. Do not treat this chair as suitable for ice, deep water or every kerb. Ask our team about any route you are uncertain about before attempting it.

Check the rules before road use

A powered wheelchair’s permitted use depends on its classification and specification. A model name or an “all-terrain” description does not establish road eligibility. Ask Bentech Medical to confirm the classification of your exact chair, and check the current GOV.UK guidance on powered wheelchair classes before planning road journeys.

Plan transport and storage

Check folded dimensions, the weight of each removable part and safe lifting arrangements against your vehicle. Measure the boot opening as well as the space inside. Follow the manual when folding, disassembling and securing the chair.

Choose with support

Compare the XSTO range or contact our UK team to discuss your requirements. A demonstration helps you assess the chair’s controls, seating and handling in person.

before.body:
Flying with a powered wheelchair requires careful preparation to ensure your mobility device arrives safely and without hassle. XSTO UK's flagship product, the XSTO M4, is designed with air travel in mind, featuring airline-approved lithium battery options and foldable, detachable components to meet airline requirements.

Your Pre-Flight Powered Wheelchair Checklist

  • Know Your Chair: Record the XSTO M4’s dimensions (length, width 580mm, height), weight (approximately 49.5kg), make, model, and serial number. Take clear photos from all angles and save copies on your phone and printed for check-in and gate personnel.
  • Battery Regulations: The M4 uses a 25.55V 15.6Ah lithium battery with a range of up to 17 km and charging time of about 4-5 hours. XSTO offers smaller 24V-10.4 Ah battery options compliant with most airline watt-hour (Wh) limits. Airlines generally allow removable lithium batteries up to 300 Wh in the cabin, so confirm your model’s battery Wh rating and prepare necessary compliance documentation.
  • Disassembly: Detach headrests, footplates, joystick, and cushions as per the XSTO manual. The M4 quickly folds and disassembles into three parts, with the heaviest piece under 25 kg, easing transport and storage.
  • Documentation: Carry user manuals, battery compliance letters, airline policies, and insurance papers in a dedicated folder or digitally. Prepare a simple laminated handling card showing disassembly, freewheel mode activation, and lift points to assist handling staff.

Inform and Coordinate

Notify your airline at least 48 hours in advance with details about the wheelchair’s size, weight, battery type, and special requirements like aisle chairs or pre-boarding. Confirm that your requests are noted in the booking record and request a confirmation letter.

Boarding and Security

Arrive early—two hours for short-haul and three for long-haul—to allow time for check-in, security, and gate assistance. Be prepared to remove and pack detachable parts safely. Show staff how to switch your chair to freewheel mode and explain lift points to prevent damage. Use protective covers included or recommended by XSTO.

Protect Your Wheelchair

Use sturdy padded cases or covers for transport. Secure joystick, screens, and battery terminals with foam or bubble wrap as airline policies allow. Label all parts with your contact details and flight information clearly.

At the Airport and On Arrival

Ensure your wheelchair is not placed on baggage belts and request "no belt" handling at check-in. Tag your chair clearly and verify where you will receive it upon landing—for example, at the aircraft door, arrival gate, or designated mobility reclaim.

Upon reclaim, examine your chair thoroughly for damage, test controls, and retain photos as evidence if repairs or claims are needed. If delayed or damaged, report immediately, request a Property Irregularity Report, and ask about loan or rental chairs.

XSTO UK-Specific Travel Notes

  • The XSTO M4 is air travel approved with appropriate battery options.
  • It features app-enabled remote control for easy monitoring.
  • The chair’s foldable and modular design supports easy handling at airports.
  • For longer trips, request assistance and clarify return points at each airport.
  • XSTO UK offers guidance and support to prepare your powered wheelchair for seamless air travel.

Conclusion

Flying with your XSTO powered wheelchair can be smooth with the right preparation: thorough documentation, knowing airline regulations, protecting your chair, and communicating clearly with airline staff. Start your journey with confidence knowing your XSTO chair is designed for modern travel demands.

For personalised advice or assistance planning your next flight with an XSTO powerchair, contact XSTO UK’s expert team — making mobility travel effortless and reliable.

Air travel with a powered wheelchair needs advance planning. Acceptance depends on the exact chair, battery and airline arrangements for each flight. We do not describe an XSTO battery as universally “airline approved”.

Speak to the airline before booking

The UK Civil Aviation Authority advises passengers to give airlines their mobility aid’s details in advance. Provide its make, model, dimensions, weight and full battery information. Explain whether the chair folds or separates into parts, and bring its operating manual.

Ask the airline to confirm its requirements for your particular chair and battery on every flight, including connections. Check how the chair will be handled and where you will transfer to airport or aircraft seating.

Get the correct documents

Contact Bentech Medical for the information available for your exact XSTO model and battery configuration. Use the battery label and the documentation supplied with your chair; do not rely on generic battery figures from an older article.

Prepare your chair

Follow the manufacturer’s instructions and the airline’s agreed handling arrangements. Photograph the chair before travel and keep important documents accessible. Discuss protection for removable parts and controls with your airline.

To explore the range before planning a trip, compare XSTO models or book a demonstration.

Power Wheelchair Comparison: Drive Type, Battery Range, Seat Size, and Transport Ease

When choosing a power wheelchair, understanding variations in drive types like front, mid, and rear-wheel drives is essential because they affect turning radius and kerb handling. XSTO's patented M4 model features omni-directional Mecanum wheels for agile manoeuvrability indoors and outdoors.

Battery technology is pivotal: XSTO uses lightweight 25.55V 15.6Ah lithium batteries that charge fully in about 4-5 hours and provide up to 17 km (about 11 miles) of range—ideal for daily commutes and trips. The chair folds quickly and disassembles into three parts for easy transport, with a folded size compact enough to fit in most car boots.

Seat width, adjustable heights (from approximately 55.5 cm to 73 cm), backrest recline, and tilt features are tailored for pressure relief and comfort during long use. With a maximum load capacity of 150 kg (23st 8lbs), the XSTO M4 supports a wide range of users.

Choosing Your Power Wheelchair

  1. Your Lifestyle

If frequently using public transport or fitting in tight spaces, XSTO’s M4 compact footprint (58 cm wide) and tight turning radius (about 78 cm) make it exceptionally suitable. For longer days out, its battery endurance meets most urban and suburban mobility needs without overburdening weight or transportability.

Adding practical accessories like USB ports, lighting for visibility, storage baskets, and lap straps enhances daily convenience. Anti-tip wheels and smooth suspension provide predictability on slopes and uneven terrain.

  1. Your Body

The XSTO M4 offers adjustable armrests and leg rests to reduce strain and accommodate various posture needs, including tilt and recline options. Breathable cushions and lumbar supports improve comfort during longer periods seated, with footrests adjustable for leg length.

  1. Your Environment

The chair’s omni-directional wheels handle different surfaces—from carpeted floors to gravel and grass—with ease thanks to its IP54 protection grade against dust and splashes. Its rear-wheel-drive design offers stability for outdoor use while maintaining indoor agility.

Understanding Drive Systems

  • Front-wheel drive: Excellent for kerb climbing and uneven ground, but with a larger turning radius.
  • Mid-wheel drive: Smallest turning circle, ideal for indoor use but less smooth outdoors.
  • Rear-wheel drive (XSTO M4): Offers stable, straight-line performance and confident traction on rough surfaces with a turning radius suitable for indoor maneuvering.

XSTO M4 Key Features

  • Max load capacity: 150 kg
  • Weight: approx. 51 kg
  • Max speed: 6 km/h
  • Range: up to 17 km per charge
  • Charging time: 4-5 hours
  • Foldable with quick disassembly for transport
  • Adjustable seat height (555mm to 730mm)
  • Omni-directional Mecanum wheels
  • App control support
  • IP54 rated for weather resistance
  • Safety features include automatic postural balance control, anti-slip downhill function, and electromagnetic brakes
  • Available in multiple vibrant colours

Navigating Your World

XSTO’s innovative design allows easy indoor and outdoor use, with smooth transitions over curbs and obstacles. Tight indoor spaces benefit from the chair’s precise control, while outdoor environments are managed with robust traction and suspension ideal for parks and urban terrains.

Real Costs and Maintenance

Total cost of ownership includes batteries, tyres, servicing, and possible add-ons like power seat lifts. XSTO offers excellent aftercare with local servicing options and parts readily available. The chair qualifies for VAT relief under UK schemes, reducing upfront costs for eligible users.

Test Driving and Longevity

XSTO recommends trying the M4 on real routes to evaluate comfort, range, and handling firsthand. Regular maintenance, including battery checks, tyre care, and cleaning, prolongs the chair’s lifespan while ensuring safety and performance.

Conclusion

The XSTO M4 provides a future-ready, reliable, and adaptable powered wheelchair choice for UK users seeking independence without compromise. Lightweight, foldable, and packed with smart technology, it is designed to fit diverse needs and lifestyles. For a bespoke fit and to arrange a trial at home or in your community, contact XSTO UK and step into a new era of mobility freedom.
